findings.body:
**Accept the optional `FailureSet` fields.**

`AnalyzeFailureSetSchema` rejects Vitest results containing `numTotalTests` at both analyze operation boundaries. This prevents callers from passing those results directly to `analyze.collectFailures` or `analyze.clusterErrors`. Mirror the optional fields from `src/ops/gates/registry.ts:126-132`.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
     exitCode: z.number().nullable(),
+    numTotalTests: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
+    advisories: z.array(z.string()).exactOptional(),
+    numPassedTests: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
+    numPassed: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
+    numSkippedTests: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
+    numPendingTests: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
+    numTodoTests: z.number().int().nonnegative().exactOptional(),
```

</details>
findings.title: Accept the optional `FailureSet` fields.

findings.body:
**Reject short numeric cluster IDs.**

`src/ops/analyze/registry.ts:427-432` pads `1234567` to `01234567`. `analyze.fix` can then select a different cluster instead of rejecting the input.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-    typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 99_999_999
-      ? String(value).padStart(8, '0')
+    typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 10_000_000 && value <= 99_999_999
+      ? String(value)
```

</details>
findings.title: Reject short numeric cluster IDs.

findings.body:
**src/ops/analyze/init.ts:202-210 — The migration staging directory is created in `input.dir`, not next to `configPath`.**

`configPath` is `resolve(input.dir, input.configPath ?? CQ_CONFIG_FILE)`. The `configPath` doc comment allows an absolute path. If that path is on another filesystem, `renameSync` throws `EXDEV`. The op then returns `failed` with "cannot migrate". If `configPath` is in another directory, `input.dir` may also be unwritable for `mkdtempSync`.

Stage the file in `dirname(configPath)`. Apply the same change to the stale-scratch sweep at lines 182-194.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-          const scratch = mkdtempSync(join(input.dir, '.cq-config-migrate-'));
+          const scratch = mkdtempSync(join(dirname(configPath), '.cq-config-migrate-'));
```

Add `dirname` to the `node:path` import. Point the `readdirSync` sweep at `dirname(configPath)` too.
</details>
findings.title: src/ops/analyze/init.ts:202-210 — The migration staging directory is created in `input.dir`, not next to `configPath`.
